description: Starts monitoring a profile so it is automatically re-crawled at a cadence you choose (daily, every_3_days or weekly), keeping its posts and stats fresh without you polling crawl_profile. Identify the profile by profileId, platform+handle, or a public profile/post URL. Managing monitoring is free; each scheduled refresh crawl costs credits (10 per refresh) and monitoring pauses itself if your balance runs out, then resumes when you top up. The profile must already be in the database; crawl_profile it first if it is not. The first refresh runs within minutes, or at refreshAtUtc ("HH:MM" UTC) when you pass it; after that each refresh is due exactly one interval after the previous scheduled time (nextCrawlDueAt in the answer and in list_tracked_profiles). Calling again on an already-monitored profile updates the cadence and keeps the refresh time, unless you pass refreshAtUtc to move it. Pull the new posts with get_tracked_updates. Cost: free.

platform.description: With handle: resolve the profile to monitor

profileId.description: Internal profile id from search results

refreshAtUtc.description: "HH:MM" 24-hour UTC: pin the refresh to this time of day (also resets it on an already monitored profile)

url.description: Public profile or post URL identifying the profile

name: track_profile
title: Monitor a Profile
